posts.title: Editorial 85mm Golden Hour Portrait with Natural Freckles
posts.excerpt: Award-winning Hasselblad H6D-100c studio portrait prompt with customizable lighting angles and skin texture controls.
posts.content:
## The Concept & Lighting Architecture

This portrait prompt is calibrated specifically for **Midjourney v6.0** and **Flux.1 Dev** to eliminate artificial plastic skin rendering. By specifying a prime 85mm focal length and directional golden hour rim lighting, the diffusion engine calculates real optical bokeh rather than synthetic blurs.

:::tip
**Pro Tip for Photographers:** Always add `--style raw` when using Midjourney v6 to disable Midjourney's default saturation boost. This retains authentic micro-skin pores and natural subsurface scattering.
:::

---

### Key Formula & Parameters:
1. **Camera Angle:** Eye-level 85mm medium portrait
2. **Key Lighting:** Low-angle 2800K warm rim light + diffused 5000K fill
3. **Texture Anchor:** Natural micro-freckles, subtle skin pore fidelity
4. **Style Parameter:** `--style raw --v 6.0 --ar 3:4`

:::info
**Compatible AI Models:** Midjourney v6, Flux.1 Schnell/Dev, Google Gemini Imagen 3, Stable Diffusion XL.
:::

---

### Video Masterclass on Portrait Lighting:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ScMzIvxBSi4

---

### Frequently Asked Questions:
:::faq
Q: How do I change the character's eye color or age?
A: Simply click the "Customize" button above or replace the [Subject] variable token with your desired demographics (e.g., "[elder craftsman with silver beard]").
Q: Why does the skin look blurry in low CFG settings?
A: For Flux.1, keep the CFG scale between 3.0 and 3.8. High CFG values cause chromatic noise, while values below 2.5 can soften facial details.
:::

posts.title: Rain-Slicked Tokyo Cyberpunk Alleyway with Holographic Reflections
posts.excerpt: Hyper-detailed rain atmosphere prompt with wet asphalt optical puddles and dense overhead cables.
posts.content:
## Atmospheric Cinematic Architecture

Capturing authentic cyberpunk environments requires avoiding hyper-saturated cartoon magenta. This prompt anchors the scene with Kodak 5247 film grain, damp street atmosphere, and realistic light refraction on asphalt puddles.

:::warning
**Avoid Cartoon Artifacts:** Do not use generic words like "cyberpunk city neon wallpaper" in your prompt. Ground your prompt in real-world photography terms like "anamorphic flare", "wet asphalt", and "Kodachrome".
:::

---

### Camera & Lens Specifications
| Setting | Recommended Value | Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Focal Length** | 35mm Anamorphic | Wide cinematic horizontal field with lens flares |
| **Aperture** | f/2.0 | Shallow depth of field for background light circles |
| **Color Temperature** | 3200K / 6500K Dual | High contrast sodium vapor vs cyan neon signs |

---

### Video Reference:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ

posts.title: The Definitive Guide: How to Structure Prompts for Astro SSG Sites
posts.excerpt: Learn how to use Astro Content Collections and Markdown frontmatter to build ultra-fast, zero-cost AI prompt libraries.
posts.content:
## Why Astro is the Ultimate Framework for Prompt Directories

When you run an AI prompt directory or photography portfolio, page speed is directly tied to user retention. Traditional server-rendered WordPress sites suffer from database queries, PHP execution overhead, and expensive hosting tiers.

:::info
**Astro SSG Speed Advantage:** Astro builds all prompt cards and articles as pure static HTML during deployment. Zero JavaScript execution on initial page render gives you an instant 100/100 Google Lighthouse score.
:::

---

### 1. Zero JavaScript by Default
Astro renders HTML at build time (SSG). Prompts, images, and camera metadata are converted to pristine static HTML, resulting in 100/100 Google Lighthouse scores.

### 2. Markdown Content Collections
Instead of storing prompts in an SQL database, Astro Content Collections store each prompt as a clean `.md` or `.json` file:

```typescript
// src/content/config.ts
import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content';

const prompts = defineCollection({
  type: 'content',
  schema: z.object({
    title: z.string(),
    model: z.string(),
    aspectRatio: z.string(),
    tags: z.array(z.string()),
    likes: z.number().default(0),
  }),
});
```

---

### 3. Cloudflare Pages + Webhook Deployments
Whenever you hit **"Publish"** in this WordPress-grade admin panel, a POST request is sent to your Cloudflare Pages Deploy Hook. Cloudflare pulls the latest commit and rebuilds the static HTML in under 20 seconds for $0/month.

:::tip
**Cost Breakdown:**
- Cloudflare Pages: $0 / month (Unlimited Bandwidth, Global CDN)
- GitHub Storage: $0 / month (Public/Private code repository)
- Sveltia / WP-Admin: $0 / month (Client-side Git CMS)
- **Total Monthly Expense: $0.00**
:::

## The Modern Prompt Directory & Studio

PromptPlum is an open-source, high-performance photography and generative AI prompt directory built on **Astro SSG**, **TypeScript**, and a **WordPress-grade Gutenberg block editor**.

### Our Mission
We provide creators, photographers, and prompt engineers with tested, verified formulas for **Midjourney v6**, **Flux.1**, **Gemini**, and **DALL·E 3**.

:::tip
**100% Free Architecture:** Built to run permanently free on Cloudflare Pages with zero monthly database or server hosting fees.
:::

---

### Key Architectural Pillars
- **Astro SSG:** Instant sub-50ms page load speeds worldwide.
- **Visual Gutenberg CMS:** True WordPress block workflow with Save Draft vs Auto-Deploy Publish.
- **Interactive Variable Engine:** Test prompt variables in browser before generating.

items.question: How do I copy and customize variable tokens like [Subject] in a prompt?
items.answer: Click the "Customize" button on any prompt card to open the interactive variable switcher. Select or type your subject/lighting, and click "Copy Customized Prompt" to copy the finalized prompt.

items.question: How does the WordPress-grade Auto-Deploy work on Cloudflare Pages?
items.answer: When you click "Save Draft", your changes are saved locally with zero build costs. When you click "Publish", the admin panel triggers your Cloudflare Deploy Hook to build and refresh static Astro HTML in ~2.8 seconds worldwide.

items.question: Is hosting and content management 100% free forever?
items.answer: Yes! Cloudflare Pages offers unlimited bandwidth and global CDN for free, GitHub stores the repository and markdown content for free, and Sveltia CMS / WP-Admin runs 100% client-side in your browser.

items.question: Which AI engines and generators are supported?
items.answer: We support Midjourney v6, Black Forest Labs Flux.1, Google Gemini (Imagen 3), ChatGPT (DALL·E 3), and Stable Diffusion XL.
